w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ THE FOCUS GROUP! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 Night. The lingering The Terms of Service gorges at the treeline — 600 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — Callback: One bad act can be redone. (Offered once, after a bad beat.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Buffering is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
Travel 3 tiles to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Fatima freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
⛔ THE OPENING CREDITS will not roll until the crew is dead. Kill THE COMMERCIAL BREAK first — node 1 of 3.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
firstContext: Armor absorbs 5.
The attack hits you for 3.
📖 Codex: Rerun — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
(stripes flowing where no wind blows's hide absorbs 1.)
💪 Your Strength grows — 6. The work is changing you.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: 🏃 A runner from Stonebridge comes in muddy and breathless. "Oscar is dead, and the fire's got two mouths arguing over it. Stonebridge is asking Haven to back a claimant."
🗣️ Sofia to Carmine, by the fire: "The pantry's the thing. We don't raise The Granary on empty shelves — 11,381 of 20,000 kcal."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.firstLine: ⛔ THE OPENING CREDITS will not roll until the crew is dead. Kill THE COMMERCIAL BREAK first — node 1 of 3.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/10/6), with 2 wave-4 and 2 wave-5 fought, 7 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 15 · Craft 10 · Talk 17 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Benoit Lambert ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,098 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
